li_projects.title: Snitch
li_projects.description: Snitch helps recruiters spot suspicious moments in remote interviews by combining behavioral signals, AI-language detection, CV checks, and visual canaries. Snitch was presented for Hack the North, Waterloo and won a 2nd prize under the GPTZero Track. Learn more about Snitch here: https://devpost.com/software/snitch-ldyzh9

li_projects.title: LLM ReviewGuard: Review Moderator
li_projects.description: Built for TikTok TechJam 2025 LLM ReviewGuard is an automated moderation framework for Google location reviews. Each review is checked against four policy categories (advertisement, irrelevant, false, and vulgar language), scored for relevance and quality, and returned with a short written justification for the decision. posts.text: WE TOOK 2ND PLACE IN THE GPTZERO TRACK AT Hack the North 2026!!! 🥹🏆❤️‍🔥 We built Snitch, a tool for spotting the use of real time AI copilots during remote interviews! We started with something we’d been seeing more and more: AI interview assistants that can listen to the interviewer and generate answers for the candidate in real time.
